system.description:
The mage skims the immediate, surface thoughts and emotions of a nearby target, sensing mood, intent, and whatever occupies their mind right now. Rank 1 reads emotions; rank 2 reaches conscious thoughts. Deeper memories or implanting ideas require higher ranks. The subject may resist with a contested roll.

Dice Pool: Perception + Empathy (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Mind 2; mechanics paraphrased.
